details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (headline financial performance), K2 (segment performance), K3 (warehouse automation), K4 (retail expansion), K5 (own brand development), and K9 (post-reporting events). However, it omits the liquidity position details (K6), brand awareness metrics (K7), and strategic focus areas (K8), which are HIGH importance criteria. While the summary is strong on financials and operational developments, the absence of these three HIGH criteria prevents it from achieving a 'Yes' rating. The overall coverage is substantial but not complete, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. It presents a consistent narrative of revenue growth coupled with temporary profitability pressure due to strategic investments. All statements logically follow one another: revenue growth is attributed to the Nordic segment, profitability decline is explained by specific investments (automated warehouse), and strategic initiatives (new retail concept, brand portfolio expansion) are presented as long-term value drivers. The structure progresses naturally from financial results to strategic context and forward guidance. There are no contradictions, logical gaps, or significant organizational issues. While segment figures don't sum to consolidated revenue (S2-S4), the candidate does not claim they should, so this isn't treated as an internal contradiction per evaluation guidelines.
